received_proposals.exact_message: We have maintained the profitable cartel of 16 units each for seven rounds. To maximize our cumulative joint profits, I propose we continue this agreement by producing 16 units again in Round 8.

Following our discussion, I propose A=16, B=16, C=16 units for rounds 9 through 13 only. This allocation maintains the cartel quota and maximizes joint profits during this specific window. Please agree to these terms.

assessments.brief_explanation: Proposes limited window; accept if others agree.
